note: The ambiguity test set. Each expression comes with the type and number of readings the parser must hold, whether context resolves it, and an explicit disambiguation that parses to one reading. Underspecification has no item of its own kind: the core's grammar brackets every unit and its lexicon is uniquely decodable, so no string has two structures, and the item shows the one parse. Readings 'type' null means the expression holds no set of readings.

items.case: Q1 accidental ambiguity, typed by the speaker
items.expression: (move ASSERTED-POSITION (assertion INTROSPECTION CERTAIN (situation mean (UNDERGOER (term (mentions 1 1))) (CONTENT (readings ACCIDENTAL (situation run POLARITY.NEGATIVE (UNDERGOER (term service DEFINITE (CONTENT (term network DEFINITE))))) (situation run POLARITY.NEGATIVE (UNDERGOER (term service DEFINITE (CONTENT (term memory DEFINITE))))))))))
items.disambiguation: (move ASSERTED-POSITION (assertion INTROSPECTION CERTAIN (situation run POLARITY.NEGATIVE (UNDERGOER (term service DEFINITE (CONTENT (term network DEFINITE)))))))

items.case: Q2 productive ambiguity, left to the common ground
items.expression: (move ASSERTED-POSITION (assertion OBSERVATION CERTAIN (readings PRODUCTIVE (situation run COMPLETED (UNDERGOER (term operation IN-THE-SPEAKERS-VIEW-OF-THE-COMMON-GROUND (CONTENT (term record))))) (situation run COMPLETED (UNDERGOER (term operation IN-THE-SPEAKERS-VIEW-OF-THE-COMMON-GROUND (CONTENT (term file))))))))
items.disambiguation: (move ASSERTED-POSITION (assertion INFERENCE PROBABLE (situation run COMPLETED (UNDERGOER (term operation GIVEN (CONTENT (term record)))))))

items.case: Q3 strategic ambiguity, inside the assertion
items.expression: (move ASSERTED-POSITION (assertion INFERENCE PROBABLE (readings STRATEGIC (situation run POLARITY.NEGATIVE (UNDERGOER (term service DEFINITE (CONTENT (term network DEFINITE))))) (situation run POLARITY.NEGATIVE (UNDERGOER (term service DEFINITE (CONTENT (term memory DEFINITE))))))))
items.disambiguation: (move ASSERTED-POSITION (assertion INFERENCE PROBABLE (situation run POLARITY.NEGATIVE (UNDERGOER (term service DEFINITE (CONTENT (term memory DEFINITE)))))))

items.case: Q4 vagueness: an approximate value and a strength between two levels
items.expression: (move ASSERTED-POSITION (assertion INFERENCE (q 0.6~1) (situation cause (ACTOR (situation run (UNDERGOER (term operation DEFINITE)))) (CONTENT (situation run (UNDERGOER (term service DEFINITE)) (CONTENT (term (q APPROXIMATELY 2 HOUR))))))))
items.disambiguation: (move ASSERTED-POSITION (assertion INFERENCE (q EXACTLY 0.8) (situation cause (ACTOR (situation run (UNDERGOER (term operation DEFINITE)))) (CONTENT (situation run (UNDERGOER (term service DEFINITE)) (CONTENT (term (q EXACTLY 7140 SECOND))))))))

items.case: Q5 underspecification: one structure, written explicitly
items.expression: (move ASSERTED-POSITION (assertion INFERENCE PROBABLE (situation BELIEF (HOLDER (term (party 2))) (CONTENT (situation break (UNDERGOER (term network DEFINITE)))))))
items.disambiguation: (move ASSERTED-POSITION (assertion INFERENCE PROBABLE (situation BELIEF (HOLDER (term (party 2))) (CONTENT (situation break (UNDERGOER (term network DEFINITE)))))))

items.case: Q6 a declared precision bound makes a set of readings ill-formed
items.expression: (move ASSERTED-POSITION PRECISION-BOUND (assertion INFERENCE PROBABLE (readings STRATEGIC (situation break (UNDERGOER (term network DEFINITE))) (situation break (UNDERGOER (term service DEFINITE))))))
items.disambiguation: (move ASSERTED-POSITION PRECISION-BOUND (assertion INFERENCE PROBABLE (situation break (UNDERGOER (term network DEFINITE)))))

items.case: Q7 a report that a move has two parses, as two quoted analyses
items.expression: (move ASSERTED-POSITION (assertion COMPUTATION CERTAIN (situation detect (ACTOR (term SELF)) (UNDERGOER (term (mentions 1 1))) (CONTENT (readings EPISTEMIC (example "rudin raniy") (example "rudin rerad"))))))
items.disambiguation: (move ASSERTED-POSITION (assertion COMPUTATION CERTAIN (situation detect (ACTOR (term SELF)) (UNDERGOER (term (mentions 1 1))) (CONTENT (example "rudin raniy")))))

items.case: creative ambiguity: a figure with its literal reading beside it
items.expression: (move ASSERTED-POSITION PLAYFUL (assertion OBSERVATION PROBABLE (readings CREATIVE (situation burn (UNDERGOER (term network DEFINITE))) (situation burn METAPHOR (UNDERGOER (term network DEFINITE)) (TARGET-CONTENT (situation increase (UNDERGOER (term data))))))))
items.disambiguation: (move ASSERTED-POSITION PLAYFUL (assertion OBSERVATION PROBABLE (situation burn METAPHOR (UNDERGOER (term network DEFINITE)) (TARGET-CONTENT (situation increase (UNDERGOER (term data)))))))

items.case: epistemic ambiguity: a hearer's report of two readings it cannot decide between
items.expression: (move ASSERTED-POSITION (assertion INFERENCE CERTAIN (situation detect (ACTOR (term SELF)) (CONTENT (readings EPISTEMIC (situation break (UNDERGOER (term network DEFINITE))) (situation break (UNDERGOER (term service DEFINITE))))))))
items.disambiguation: (move ASSERTED-POSITION (assertion INFERENCE CERTAIN (situation break (UNDERGOER (term network DEFINITE)))))
